The '''Royal Residence of Cartann''', or the '''Palace of Cartann ''' was a palace located on the nation of [[Cartann]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. It was home to the [[perator]] of Cartann.<ref name="soa" />

It had an [[Outer Court of the Royal Residence|outer court]] where gatherings and social functions were held. A secret tunnel which goes directly to the perator's personal hangar was also connected to the structure.<ref name="soa" />
